Marissa — thanks for flagging.

High-level math: if we commit to 24 months and include GHE under the reseller bundle, my back-of-envelope says total committed spend could reduce unit cost by roughly 10% (range 6-14% depending on seat counts and support tiers). The GHE spreadsheet Kevin shared lists price bands — I attached a short worksheet in Renewal_timeline_draft_v2.xlsx with scenarios (A: separate buys, B: bundled 12m, C: bundled 24m).

Negotiation play: ask for pricing floors + extended payment terms (net45) and a 60-day price protection clause. Also push for no-cost migration assistance from GitHub (SAML + SCIM handover) as part of the package.

I propose we schedule a 30-min sync with all vendor reps next Tue (7/13) at 2pm PT to get vendor commitments on bundling and timing. Agree?

-Karthik

Thanks — quick procurement notes:
- PO cutoff to hit Aug 2 processing: vendors need signed order forms + PO submitted by Aug 1 COB. Legal needs at least 5 business days for standard SaaS order form review (longer if we have custom security addenda).
- For Atlassian specifically: we need confirmation of data residency and SOC 2 attestation (Kevin, can you confirm current SOC 2 status and a link to the evidence?).
- If we bundle, we must route a combined SOW through our vendor risk program — that adds ~3 business days for vendor-risk intake.
